description: The script mafft of MAFFT 7.505 as a function of its command line and the text of the files it names (MafftProgram.Run), with the programs lastdb and lastal of LAST 1256 (ported, GPL) installed: --lastpair aligns every pair of nucleotide sequences with lastal (Last-INS-1). pairlocalalign -R of MAFFT 7.505 overflows its heap when three or more sequences are related (valgrind: invalid writes behind the rows of its table of local homologies; the run then crashes): such runs are refused with an error, the runs with two sequences and the runs without hits are answered. --lastmultipair stops with the messages of the script (it needs --addfragments, and dndpre does not know -Q).

arguments.description: The command-line arguments of mafft, one per element, the input file LAST (for example ["--lastpair", "--clustalout", "in.fa"]).

files.description: The text of the files the arguments name: file name -> content (the input FASTA, --addfragments / --add / --merge / --seed files ...).

stdin.description: Text of standard input (read when the input file is '-').

stderr.description: Standard error (the messages of the programs and of the script)

files.description: The files the run wrote (tree and distance files ...)

errors.message: arguments must contain the command-line arguments of mafft (the input file last).

output.stderr: (the messages of pairlocalalign, lastal and tbfast; ends with 'Pairwise alignments were computed by LAST')
